name: fire-tv-overlay
description: Fire TV overlay client — renders the §3.4 payload pushed over the Overlay WebSocket. Plain TypeScript, no framework; hosted in the transparent WebView on Vega OS or an Android WebView on Fire OS.
$comment: Not an npm workspace — see decision D030, the same constraint as web/package.json. Declares no dependencies: the client is plain TypeScript against the DOM and WebSocket platform APIs.
